verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers SSO, SCIM, event hooks, MCP server, and Cross App Access, but contains no mention of AI/data retention policies, deletion controls, or privacy-posture settings related to AI-native usage of Okta data. No documentation addresses how a user could control retention or deletion of data used in AI workflows. Missing for 10: any data retention policy documentation, deletion/export controls, AI-specific data handling terms.
